description: This file defines the interface for managing session IDs, including functions to retrieve the session ID, get process depth, and release resources.

methods.name: tr2_sid_get
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID, computing it if necessary.

methods.name: tr2_sid_depth
methods.description: Returns the process depth within the session hierarchy.

methods.name: tr2_sid_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the session ID.
